name: Sticky Fingers
description: Causes transactions to duplicate — you pay once, the merchant receives twice, or vice versa. Nobody gains consistently. The errors are random and self-correcting over time.
observed_behavior: Introduces transaction echo errors that reverse within 24-72 hours. Merchants and buyers both experience phantom charges and phantom refunds.
story_hooks: A merchant realizes the 'errors' always benefit the poorest customers and wonders if the E.L.F. has a sense of justice
